_note: Hierarchy walk is cwd → each parent → ~/.lingxi/. Within a directory, LINGXI.local.md (when present) precedes LINGXI.md so local overrides shadow canonical entries. CORRECTED — the old '_note' asserted 'GAP 4: there is NO per-file size drop', citing leaked TS (loader.ts safelyReadMemoryFileAsync). The 2.1.220 BINARY skips: Eds (@230805636) routes every memory file through EG (@229022173) — 'let o=await e.stat(t); if(!o.isFile()||o.size>r) return n?.(o),null' — with r = ELu = 4194304 (@230811638). The walk still DISCOVERS an oversized file (the guard is in the reader, not the scanner); it is dropped at load, which is what expected_skipped now records. Separately, the 40k-char limit really is a non-blocking warning only. Case-insensitive matching is OS-layer best-effort; mismatches emit tengu_memory_case_mismatch but do not block load. (Managed tier is exercised separately in hierarchy unit tests.)
